newsitem.title: USA: Ottawa Financial to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Ottawa Financial to buy back shares.

text.p: Ottawa Financial Corp said Tuesday it plans to repurchase up to five percent of its outstanding shares in the open market.

The shares will be purchased at prevailing market prices from time to time depending upon market conditions. As of May 31, Ottawa Financial had $866.4 million in assets, $74.8 million in stockholders' equity and 4,919,458 shares outstanding.

Gordon Grevengoed, president, said the board of directors approved the repurchase in view of the current price level of the company's common stock and the strong capital position of its AmeriBank subsidiary.
Ottawa Financial shares traded up 3/8 at 22.
"We believe that the repurchase of our shares represents an attractive investment opportunity which will benefit the corporation and our stockholders," he added.
Repurchased stock will become treasury shares and will be used for general corporate purposes.
